name: Claude Ship
description: Reviews, fixes and policy-approves GitHub pull requests with Anthropic's Code Review, PR Steward and Approvals agents plus /ship in Claude Code, for Team and Enterprise plans.

skills.name: Code Review
skills.description: Reviews GitHub pull requests for logic errors, security vulnerabilities and broken edge cases, posting inline comments ranked by severity.

skills.name: PR Steward
skills.description: Pushes commits that fix failing checks, resolve merge conflicts and address review comments on your team's open GitHub pull requests.

skills.name: Claude Approvals
skills.description: Checks pull requests against an approval policy file in your repository, reports who still has to approve, and can post an approving review.

skills.name: /ship and /steward
skills.description: Opens a pull request from your Claude Code CLI session, reviews the change, then works on feedback and failing checks until it is ready to merge.
